finding.headline: "The Salon-Dependent Diaspora Mum"
finding.problem: "Back home my sister would hold the baby while I sat in the salon. Here I have nobody. My hair is in 'survival mode' and I feel invisible."
finding.person: 35-yr-old Naija mum in Houston, pre-baby got hair done every 3 weeks; now 3 months in, bonnet + scrunchie, no one to watch baby for a salon trip.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone → "The At-Home Protective Style Mini-Guide for New Mums (No Salon, No Village)"". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
